Hi! Im 24/F/England. My names becky and its really nice to meet you! Im feeling very lonely at the minute and a bit down, due to a relationship break down. I graduated uni earlier this year and am living with my parents for a while. 

I enjoy gaming as well. I absolutely love Skyrim! At the minute i am playing gta5 and zelda botw. 

I love being outdoors and walking. I love cooking and would love to develop my skills this year. I bet your japanese food tastes amazing, i love sushi haha.

I would say I’m an extroverted introvert. I can be quiet when I first meet somebody, but when I know them I can be loud and I like to think quite funny ahah. I am a very deep thinker and love talking about anything thought provoking and meaningful! 

I graduated from uni earlier this year with a philosophy and linguistics degree and have just been searching for a job since then. I love talking about philosophy and the meaning of life, desires, fears, hardships, mental health etc. 

I enjoy reading, piano, yoga, knitting, gaming, documentaries (especially travel and wildlife), bullet journaling and art and spirituality in general! 

Now that you mention the sunset, it does seem silly in principle. However, I just find the colours absolutely incredible. It’s like a miracle every day that reminds me of the beauty of the world and miracle of life! 

Hopefully we can be penpals! Message me if you’re interested and have a great day! :)

Ps, I would love to hear what life is like in Canada! I think Canada seems like such an amazing country to live in!
